Please read this before you travel

Urgent Travel Notice for Animal Carriage

Travelers must review their animal arrangements before departure and keep all forms and carriers ready for inspection.

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk is responsible for safe handling and clear records for every animal movement. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. Handlers use calm, humane methods around animals, and each care plan is matched to the species, temperament, and comfort of the animal.

Please ensure that carriers are secure, clean, and suitable for the animal inside them. Food, water, medication, and comfort items should be packed only when approved, and the animal must be presented in the condition described on the booking record. Any change in behavior, health, or travel readiness should be reported at once so the desk can update the file and advise the next step.

Travelers should remain close to the desk area while checks are being completed and should follow staff instructions without delay. If an animal becomes distressed, handlers may pause the process and apply the safest care measure available. This is routine practice and is taken to protect both the traveler and the animal.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for immediate assistance and final travel guidance.
